reasoning: Mango leaf showing diffuse reddish-brown to dark purplish-brown discoloration across large areas of the leaf surface. No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery Mildew), no black sooty layer (rules out Sooty Mould), no galls or insect feeding damage (rules out Gall Midge and Cutting Weevil). The irregular brown blotching pattern coalescing across the leaf is characteristic of Anthracnose on mango.
